title: destination profiles, honest measurement, dialogue-first ducking without pumping

expect.profiles: resolveProfile() is rasanai-house: -14 LUFS +/-1, check ceiling -1.0 dBTP, limiter -1.5 dBTP (the old defaults). ebu-r128 is -23 +/-0.5 / -1. An unknown id falls back to house and says so. No profile is called universal
expect.ok: house profile: measured ok true (loudness within tolerance, peak under the ceiling, clipped 0); deferred lists mono_downmix and phone_speaker (not claimed from channel count)
expect.loud: errors integrated-loudness (with a gain fix), true-peak, clipping; ok false
expect.short: error duration (57.4 s vs 60 s: a tail may have been cut); clipping is 'info: unmeasured', not a pass
expect.ebu: the 'ok' measures against ebu-r128 fail integrated-loudness (-14.2 vs -23)
expect.ducking: dense spans -> pumping-risk flag (8 ducks in ~12 s); single merges both spans into one lane (gap 0.8 s < 1.2 s) so ducks 1; depth 5 dB, release 0.8 s, depth capped at 9 dB when asked for 14
